report.previous_run_delta: Recovered/newly actionable: Anna AI OS's Founding Builder qualification window is active through November 30, with a September-only launch boost, recurring cash grants tied to verified MAU, and bundled app infrastructure. Recovered: Vercel's Ling 3.0 Flash Fin remains free through September 25 via a charge-safe model ID. Closing today: MiniMax M3/M2.7 free routes end September 6 at an unpublished time. OrcaRouter voucher claims were excluded because the primary offer page could not be fetched; other prior signals were unchanged and not recycled.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED PROGRAM SURFACE; CASH AWARDS CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED USAGE
signals.changed: The September 1-November 30 qualification window is live. September is the one boosted measurement month: an approved app reaching 200/500/1,000/4,000/10,000/20,000 qualified MAU earns $80/$200/$400/$1,600/$4,000/$6,000; later recurring awards are $50/$100/$200/$1,000/$2,500/$5,000 per month. Anna states an $80,000 monthly program budget and says existing qualified apps are protected if admissions later pause.
signals.free_value: Self-serve developer access plus a platform layer for app UI, hosting, sandboxed execution, user accounts, persistent memory, LLM orchestration, native components, marketplace distribution, free-user credits, and BYOK support. Exact per-builder free quotas were not published in the primary program rules.
signals.approximate_value: $80-$6,000 for September and $50-$5,000 in later qualifying months, conditional on real signed-in users completing meaningful runs; plus unpriced hosted infrastructure and distribution.
signals.cash_required: $0 program fee and no card requirement was identified in public developer onboarding. External APIs, paid model usage, taxes, and any optional promotion can create costs.
signals.fit: Indie hackers and solo developers are explicitly targeted. No incorporation, funding, company-age, revenue, geography, or team-size gate is stated, but identity/payment compliance applies before payout.
signals.catch: A complete independently usable AI-native app with UI and backend must pass review; bare scripts/MCP servers do not qualify. Developer/test traffic is excluded. At least 200 genuine signed-in MAU is required, maintenance is monthly, payouts follow audit, and platform lock-in/distribution uncertainty are real.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED FORGOTTEN-SIGNAL RECOVERY; PRIMARY PRICING VERIFIED
signals.changed: Recovered while still actionable: Vercel made Inclusion AI's finance-focused Ling 3.0 Flash Fin free through September 25, including a dedicated -free identifier that returns an error after expiry instead of billing.
signals.free_value: Zero-priced API inference for a 256K-context, 32K-output model supporting reasoning, function calling, and multi-step financial research/tool workflows.
signals.approximate_value: Unquantified because no promotional token/request quota is published. The useful value is a bounded comparison on public financial or property-underwriting evidence.
signals.fit: No startup, incorporation, funding, domain-email, or team-size gate is stated for the promotional route; a Vercel account/API key is required.
signals.catch: Capability claims are publisher/provider claims and were not independently reproduced. Privacy guarantees were not established for sensitive financial data; only public or sanitized inputs should be used.

program_surface_results: Anna AI OS survived verification because its official program rules explicitly target indie hackers, publish MAU thresholds and payout tiers, permit porting existing apps/agents/MCP-backed products, and state a live qualification window.
Google Cloud's up-to-$350,000 AI startup tier was not escalated because the high-value path remains tied to equity funding and is not a new bootstrap-access delta.
Hackathons with prizes but no guaranteed material operating capacity were excluded.
omissions_errors: Anna's exact free compute, storage, model-token, and sandbox quotas were not published in the primary program rules.
No independent Anna payout history or current marketplace MAU distribution was verified.
OrcaRouter's offer page timed out, so secondary claims about free frontier-model vouchers were excluded.
Ling Flash Fin benchmarks and privacy posture were not independently verified.
